limitations: This verification establishes archive bytes and binding consistency only. It does not compile Lean, run native proof replay, execute axiom audits, establish an elaborated declaration census or admit drafts to the library.
Historical receipts, failed/stale variants and original paths retain only their original source/dependency/object provenance qualifications.
External mathlib/dependency source observations are retained hash observations, not a bundled full dependency-source replay or object-authentication guarantee.
The frozen manifests retain their original pending-review fields; exact independent reviews and current archive scope records explain subsequent static review without rewriting historical bytes.
Historical local paths and operational identifiers are deliberately retained; prior credential-pattern screening was heuristic, not a complete secret-exclusion proof.

No claim follows for signed energy/supplier bounds, pointwise amplitude, strict negative/joint sectors, arbitrary transformed or renormalized realization, RH or its converse, A=0 equality, or C-infinity smoothness.
This record does not certify a remote commit, push, merge, branch/worktree cleanup, future archive changes or unobserved dynamic extractor controls.
